San Isidro — Madrid, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

San Isidro (including Alto de San Isidro) has the most extensive documented safety coverage of Carabanchel's barrios: past reports of assaults on police officers, systematic car theft and vandalism, drug distribution and around 80 illegally squatted flats; a decade-long narcopiso at a specific address that was finally cleared by police in July 2021 after repeated reports of violence and theft including against schoolchildren. The recurrence of serious, independently reported incidents supports a red rating at night. Sources checked: Madridiario, Jan 2013; Telemadrid, Jun 2017; Telemadrid, Oct 2020 & Jul 2021 (x2); decide.madrid.es citizen proposal.
